question: What overall form should the diagram from square to bindu have?
premises: The diagram includes elements from the sixteen-spoked part up to the bindu.
The four-cornered enclosure is part of this structure.
inference: O goddess, the structure from the four-cornered enclosure through the sixteen-spoked elements up to the bindu should be level.
plain_english: O goddess, the four-cornered figure and the parts from the sixteen spokes up to the bindu should be level.
